all_passages.content: We are very conservative. PPF we both contribute to maximum — 1.5 lakhs each. NPS for my husband's retirement. Some RDs. And gold — we have a lot of gold from my side of the family. South Indian families, you know, gold is everything.
That sounds good but I'm suspicious. How? Gold earning money sounds like those chit fund scams. I've heard of people losing money.

Lending my gold to jewellers? But what if jeweller doesn't return? In south India many people have lost gold this way — given to a jeweller for work and he runs away. This is a trauma for many families.
5-7% is attractive. That's like PPF returns but on gold which also grows in value. But my concern is: this is a mobile app company? Not a bank? Not post office?
I don't use fintech for big amounts. I use SBI, post office. These I trust because they've been there for 50 years. How long has CoinDCX been there?
Oh, in money. Not in gold. So gold price also keeps changing, and I'm getting money on top?
That's complicated. I prefer simple products. PPF — I put in money, I know what I get. This has too many moving parts.
Route 1 — definitely. 'Always yours, always safe.' Safety is everything for me. Returns come second.
Post office or SBI should offer this. Same concept but through a channel I trust. Or if my bank sends me an SMS about this, I might enquire. App-only products I don't trust for large amounts.

Good idea but wrong company for people like me. Either get a bank to co-brand this, or get a credible endorsement from somewhere. And simplify the explanation — 'your gold earns 5-7% per year, like interest on an FD but on your gold' — one line, simple, clear. That I can explain to my husband.
